title: Arunachal Pradesh to Host Asian Rafting Championships 2026 on Simang River
summary: Hosted at Boleng from Oct 5–9, 2026. Official Mascot: Nyami.

items: Arunachal Pradesh selected to host Asian Rafting Championships 2026 on the Simang River in Siang district.
Organised by International Rafting Federation (IRF) and Indian Rafting Foundation.
